description: This Java source file defines the final class ThingAcknowledgementsFactory, which provides factory methods for creating and parsing Acknowledgements objects related to 'Thing' entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating acknowledgements with specific parameters and for deserializing acknowledgements from JSON representations.

classes.name: ThingAcknowledgementsFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods for creating and parsing acknowledgements related to 'Thing' entities in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgements instance from a collection of Acknowledgement objects and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgements instance with specific entity ID, acknowledgements, status code, and headers, suitable for deserialization.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject to produce an Acknowledgements instance.
